status: Implemented locally. Focused persistence, purchase, app and native checks pass; owner price/touch acceptance and account rollout remain.

requirements.EC01: Persistent earned balance and permanent ownership across restarts.
requirements.EC02: Legitimate completed races earn Coins; account grants require server verification.
requirements.EC03: Buy existing liveries/kit parts; retain fitted cosmetics and free stock/plain paint/colours/stickers/racing.
requirements.EC04: Atomic/idempotent writes, durable account purchase retries and revision/account fences.

proposed_prices.acceptance: Stated defaults used provisionally; optional owner question received no reply during implementation.

implementation.guest: LocalRecords guest_coins v1 holds balance, owned IDs and a monotonic committed-attempt sequence. The app stages Coins and commits them with PB/history in one atomic save. Failed commits expose neither new Coins nor a new PB. Old attempt sequences stay fenced without an unbounded receipt list. Guest coins never import into accounts.
implementation.account: Database-owned CoinWallet, CosmeticUnlock, CoinReward and CoinMilestone rows. Only successful worker verification credits a run, in the acceptance/PB transaction. Player ownership serializes purchases; the server checks its catalog price and affordability. Each request pins the displayed expected_price and a durable idempotency key, so a changed quote cannot silently charge a different amount.
implementation.recovery: One account-scoped pending purchase is saved before sending. Ambiguous replies retry the same operation on refresh or the bounded 15-second timer. Revision fences reject older snapshots; identity/epoch fences reject stale replies. Failed guest purchase saves roll back debit and unlock together. Account deletion erases local recovery and server coin rows without changing existing v1 erasure stage indices.
implementation.ownership: Liveries unlock across the five cars; kits are individual existing Compact parts. Stock/plain paint/colours/stickers stay free. A one-time cosmetic_legacy migration retains previously fitted designs/parts on this device, including after reset; it never submits an account entitlement or balance grant.
implementation.ui: Existing model photos show Free/Owned/price. Garage displays saved balance and labels Guest coins. A priced confirmation opens before locked items change the car; insufficient funds disables Buy. Success equips only on the original active car/page/account. Existing clean-car washing gates remain. Race Complete shows saved guest receipts or pending/credited account receipts; server rewards do not require visiting it.
implementation.preserved: Unlimited ordinary racing/restarting, free existing cars, actual per-car cosmetics/condition, retained native car/camera/room, reflection and photo bounds, canonical physics/rules/compiler and existing resume/real-money commerce promises. No energy, daily earned-coin exhaustion, ad grant, real-money product or runtime AI dependency added.

rewards.percentile: Highest newly reached tier per metric: top 50%=50, 25%=100, 10%=200, 1%=500. Account tiers use one verified PB per eligible actual driver on the pinned board; repeated tiers do not pay again.
rewards.challenge: First counted attempt per challenge +50; first verified beaten outcome per challenge +100.
rewards.clean: The existing +200 clean bonus remains local to guests using actual incident facts. Current trajectory verification proves completion rather than collision-free driving. No client clean flag/telemetry mints account Coins; no account clean bonus is credited without such evidence.
rewards.history: Previously displayed provisional rewards are not retroactively minted. Future verified results credit automatically. First-track/tier milestones and reward identities survive ordinary race-history retention.
rewards.bounds: Nonnegative signed-32-bit balances and guest sequence; overflow grants are explicitly capped rather than wrapping.

contracts.rollout: This task did not migrate/deploy a running service/database. Account purchases need a matching backend/worker with migration0037 plus any later release migrations. Older servers show Coin shop needs a server update. Guest saves/purchases work locally.
